draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.90, the 143rd-best grade among 241 2018 draftees and 18th of 32 at WR. He lasted until pick 194, well after his grade rank (143rd): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 285 receiving yards in 2017, 31st of 31 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 75 career games and 25 starts over 6 completed seasons.
